meta.notes: Reads the specification at run time; no existing file is modified.

technical_ai.explanation: Extended counts exceed the class-I-only counts by the mitigations that are fully required (or touched) only through legacy targets: {"fully_required_only_via_legacy": ["AML.M0036"], "touched_only_via_legacy": ["AML.M0039"]}

in_scope_mitigations_only.note: M(t) restricted to mitigations with a non-empty mapping; mitigations deliberately left unmapped as outside the scope of product evaluation (['AML.M0000', 'AML.M0001']) are dropped; techniques whose only mitigations are out of scope score 0.

design.rule: reassigned grades chosen uniformly without replacement among existing grades; F -> P or none, P -> F or none with probability 1/2 each; the crosswalk is perturbed as one pool of grades across the five frameworks (the CSF high-priority subset inherits the CSF perturbation)

design.additions: in addition, as many new grades as were reassigned (F or P with probability 1/2) are placed on uniformly chosen ungraded cells: ATLAS, mapped mitigations x services and assurance rows; crosswalk, applicable units x all elements of X_ext. Secondary analysis (omission errors), not requested by the reviewer.

T4_marginal_contributions.definition: LOO(x) = metric(X_ext) - metric(X_ext without x); group removal analogous; contribution over legacy = metric(X_leg + {x}) - metric(X_leg) for x in X_ai; Shapley values are exact (airport-game formula for max-coverage games, verified by enumeration) and add up to metric(X_ext).

T5_profile_level.definition: X_p = services of the closed reference profile (any level; the mappings are not level-specific) + assurance rows whose first '+' mark is at G-k <= G of the profile + X:PROFILE + X:AIPROFILE. 'profile_legacy_base' = services of the legacy base profile of ND TZI 2.5-005-99 + legacy rows at <= G + X:PROFILE. 'level_aware_from_rationale' additionally withdraws the credit of a service when the mitigation's rationale names a higher level of that service than the profile requires (heuristic regex extraction).

profile.domain: Attack/anomaly detector for an industrial control system (critical infrastructure; Annex III(2) when used as a safety component)
Medical-imaging triage (high-risk via Annex I, Regulation (EU) 2017/745)
Creditworthiness scoring of natural persons (Annex III(5)(b))
LLM-based agent for access to public services (Annex III(5)(a); Art. 50 transparency)
Remote biometric identification (Annex III(1)(a); Art. 14(5) dual verification)
